verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser publishes a first-party API reference (an /docs/api-reference/ endpoint page for fetching a web page), and its docs include code snippets. However, nothing shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in-page, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at any common path. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable examples within the reference, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
